content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Automation Roadmap Alignment - Phase 2 Review
agenda_items: Discussion on technology stack selection for new automation platforms
Deep dive into proposed Phase 2 automation opportunities (Supply Chain, Production, Customer Experience)
key_decisions: Approved preliminary budget allocation for initial proof-of-concept projects within the next 3 months.

Prioritized three key automation initiatives for Phase 2: Predictive Maintenance (Production), Automated Logistics Orchestration (Supply Chain), and AI-driven Customer Service Bots (Customer Experience).
Formed a cross-functional task force to evaluate potential platform vendors for robotic process automation (RPA) and intelligent automation (IA) technologies.
attendees: Dr. Anya Sharma (Global Head of Strategy)
Ms. Isabella Rossi (Head of Digital Transformation)
Mr. Hiroshi Tanaka (Director of Supply Chain Innovation)
Ms. Elena Petrova (Lead Consultant, Automation Strategy)
